artifacts.what: UnivaStoryboardAgent univa storyboard — A UniVA-style storyboard document for the whole video. It defines a cast of 2 character(s) with their visual descriptions, and breaks the story into 12 ordered shots — each shot specifying its setting, plot beat, static visual description, planned camera, and duration. It is the upstream creative source used by the keyframe and video steps to render and animate each shot of the story. A storyboard depicting a retired watchmaker's race against midnight to repair his late wife's cherished pocket watch.
artifacts.why: This storyboard captures the emotional journey of the watchmaker, from focused determination and frustration to a breakthrough, culminating in a poignant moment of peace and connection at the start of a new year, fulfilling the user's storyline.

artifacts.what: A standalone visual identity reference of the character 'retired watchmaker' (id=char_1). It depicts the character in isolation to fix their canonical appearance, not in any particular shot of the storyboard timeline.
artifacts.why: Used internally by the UniVA keyframe step as a consistency anchor when rendering shot keyframes that include this character. Not itself a frame in the final video — it is a reference sheet.
